title: Release Readiness Pipeline
interviewAnswer: A public release is ready only when its candidate file set is privacy-checked, its demo contracts validate, tests pass, a production build succeeds, and a fresh clone reproduces those results.
explanation: Repository visibility is the final switch, not the first validation step.
summary: This synthetic lesson shows the publication gates used for the public code showcase.

sections.heading: Validate the candidate file set
body: The verifier inspects tracked files plus unignored additions, matching what a release commit would contain instead of scanning only the current Git index.
It rejects ignored-product boundaries, local machine paths, credential-shaped files, and private-source imports before any remote operation occurs.

sections.heading: Prove a fresh clone works
body: The default install, test, and build path uses tracked synthetic data. Authorized contributors opt into private content with explicit commands.
This makes public CI representative of the experience a recruiter or engineer receives after cloning the repository.

callout.title: Publication rule
callout.text: Do not create the public remote until the sanitized candidate passes in a clean temporary directory.

sections.heading: Keep rollback available
body: The historical repository remains private and writable during the transition. The public repository starts with fresh history and receives only the reviewed source snapshot.
Archiving the private repository is optional and should happen only after the public repository, CI, and local private workflow are all proven.

keyTakeaways: Create the public repository from a fresh sanitized history, never a fork or mirror.
Keep the private archive active until rollback is no longer needed.
versionNotes: Synthetic public demonstration content; not part of the learning curriculum.

followUps.question: Why not archive the private repository immediately?
followUps.answer: GitHub archives are read-only. Keeping the private repository active preserves a recovery and comparison point while the new public source is being verified.
